styleLock.direction: street-smart kids apparel commerce, editorial energy with clean infographic discipline
styleLock.backgroundSystem: seamless studio sweep #FFFFFF for packshots and variant flat lays, concrete-tone panel #E4E4DF for benefit and trust screens, matte info panel #F5F5F2 for spec and detail screens, outdoor asphalt #4C4C4A only for the lifestyle scene; one flat accent block #F0D800 may carry a headline, one block per screen
styleLock.lightingSystem: daylight-balanced 5500-5600K key from the upper left, softbox diffusion with a bounce fill on the shadow side, true contact shadow under every hem, raking side light on texture screens, no harsh speculars, no dramatic falloff
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte paper sweep #FFFFFF, concrete step #E4E4DF, asphalt ground #4C4C4A, printed fabric field #5A6B47 only inside garment artwork areas; surfaces stay unwrinkled and free of debris
styleLock.typography: one modern geometric sans-serif for all Chinese and Latin labels, plus one bold condensed display weight reserved for headline blocks; Chinese copy always rendered as 「{selling_point_N}」/「{callout_N}」; headline 28-48pt, subline 16-20pt, label 10-14pt, per-screen copy budget under 50 characters
styleLock.iconSystem: thin single-weight line icons in #1F1F1F for care, spec and proof labels, no filled emblems, no certificate artwork, no seal realism
styleLock.presentationRules: the top and bottom piece always read as one set with the same scale across screens; garment silhouettes fully visible on light screens, mid-shot crop allowed on benefit and spec screens; consistent slight 3/4 or straight-on product attitude, head cropped out whenever a frame is worn
noDrift: no color palette changes and no new accent colors
no mixed fonts and no handwritten or retro lettering
no random backgrounds or stock-photo interiors
no inconsistent lighting direction or missing contact shadows
no mismatched icon styles and no invented badge artwork
no adult or teen model proportions on children's garments
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent street-smart children's apparel visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of seamless studio background #FFFFFF, label ink #1F1F1F, printed-fabric surface #5A6B47 used only inside garment artwork, and one accent #F0D800; daylight-balanced 5500-5600K lighting with an upper-left softbox key, bounce fill and true contact shadows; one modern geometric sans-serif plus one bold condensed display weight for headline blocks only; background system of paper sweep #FFFFFF, concrete panel #E4E4DF, matte info panel #F5F5F2 and asphalt #4C4C4A for the lifestyle screen; thin single-weight line icon style in #1F1F1F; garments always presented as one matching set with stable scale and flat unwrinkled surfaces; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

shots.intent: 搜索列表里一眼看清是一套衣服而不是单件T恤，抢点击率并满足白底主图合规。
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level, full silhouette of both pieces visible, centered composition, nothing clipped
shots.lighting: bright even high-key studio light, front-left softbox key with bounce fill on the shadow side, soft contact shadow under the hems, 5600K
shots.promptTemplate: Product photography of {product}, a children's two-piece outfit with the top and the bottom shown together as one set. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Straight-on eye-level camera, full silhouette visible and centered, both pieces hung flat with a natural front drape. Bright even high-key studio lighting with a front-left softbox key and a bounce fill on the shadow side, soft contact shadow under the hems so nothing floats. Seamless paper sweep #FFFFFF as background and surface. Props: none. The set occupies 60-70% of the frame and no edge is clipped. 8K commercial apparel e-commerce quality. Negative: no model, no hands, no face, no props, no watermark, no fake logo, no rendered text, no decorative graphics, no gradient background, no cut-off edges.

shots.intent: 一秒法则：把套装最大差异点（后背大面积图案与宽松版型）在首屏海报里直接讲完。

shots.lighting: open-shade daylight at 5600K from the upper left, soft directional shadow falling to the right, no speculars
shots.background: concrete panel #E4E4DF with one flat accent block #F0D800 on the right third as the headline field
shots.textZone: right third inside the accent block #F0D800: headline at the top of the block, one support line below it
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce infographic benefit hero of {product}, worn on a child-sized frame with the head cropped outside the frame. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Photographed from behind at a low 20-degree angle looking upward, mid-shot crop from the shoulder line to mid-thigh so the printed back panel is the hero surface. Open-shade daylight at 5600K from the upper left with one soft directional shadow to the right. Background concrete panel #E4E4DF plus one flat accent block #F0D800 covering the right third as the headline field. Headline 「{selling_point_1}」 set in #1F1F1F at 44pt inside the accent block, one support line 「{callout_1}」 at 16pt below it. The outfit occupies 50-60% of the frame. Negative: no visible face, no recognizable person, no ranking or sales claims, no brand wordmark, no dense body copy, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 用三处做工特写解释结构与穿着舒适度，替家长回答耐穿好不好洗这类疑问。
shots.camera: clean 90-degree overhead angle on a flat surface, three matched tight close-up panels, identical crop and scale
shots.lighting: raking side light from the right at 5600K revealing rib rows, stitch lines and weave, soft short shadows
shots.textZone: one label line centered under each of the three panels
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce infographic detail breakdown of {product}, three matched close-up panels on one screen: the ribbed neckband of the top piece, the gathered elastic waistband of the bottom piece, and the side pocket flap with its button closure. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Photographed at a clean 90-degree overhead angle on a flat surface, each panel tightly cropped on the construction with identical scale. Raking side light from the right at 5600K that reveals rib rows, stitch lines and fabric grain, soft short shadows. Matte info panel background #F5F5F2. Label under each panel in #1F1F1F at 14pt reading 「{callout_2}」, 「{callout_3}」, 「{callout_4}」. Each detail fills 55-60% of its panel. Negative: no blurry subject, no fabricated fabric percentages, no model, no hands, no watermark, no fake logo, no dense body text.

shots.camera: flat lay photographed directly from above at a 90-degree overhead angle, two-by-two grid, equal gaps, matched scale
shots.lighting: even high-key flat lighting at 5600K, minimal contact shadow so every silhouette reads clean, identical light on all four groups
shots.textZone: one column label above each column, one color chip beneath each column
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce infographic variant board of {product} in both available colorways, each set shown front and back. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Flat lay photographed directly from above at a 90-degree overhead angle, four garment groups arranged on a two-by-two grid with equal gaps and identical scale. Even high-key flat lighting at 5600K, minimal contact shadow, the same light on all four groups. Seamless background #FFFFFF. Colorway chips under each column pinned at #FFFFFF and #1F1F1F, column labels in #1F1F1F at 14pt reading 「{callout_5}」 and 「{callout_6}」. The board occupies 60-70% of the frame overall. Negative: no mixed lighting between columns, no mismatched garment scale, no model, no invented colorway names, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.lighting: even, flat, readable light at 5500K with a soft contact shadow, no drama
shots.background: matte info panel #F5F5F2 with grid rules and figures in #1F1F1F
shots.textZone: right column holds the grid title line and the measurement rows, bottom band holds the row of thin-line care icons
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce infographic size-and-care screen for {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Straight-on eye-level camera, the set shown at a slight 3/4 angle as a mid-shot from shoulders to hem on the left, a clean measurement grid on the right. Even, flat, readable light at 5500K with a soft contact shadow under the hems. Matte info panel background #F5F5F2 with grid rules and figures in #1F1F1F. Every measurement, unit, age band and ironing temperature is filled from the seller's real chart, shown as one grid title line 「{callout_7}」; care steps drawn as five thin-line icons in #1F1F1F with no certificate artwork. provenance.notes: 由 10 屏童装详情页切片提炼，主体产品一律以 {product} 占位，换成同类童装套装仍可用。已剥离：原店铺名、品牌与标语字样；首屏大字报里的季节口号与销量排名类断言；平铺屏与细节屏上的原文案标题、装饰性英文小字与独有排版；T 恤胸前字母印花与后背大幅漫画印花的具体图文（只由用户上传的参考图经 {product_identity_lock} 承载，不写进任何文本）；儿童模特的面部与身份（模版统一裁掉头部或只拍到颈以下，不保留任何可辨识特征）；尺码表里的全部实测数值（各档后衣长、胸围、肩宽、裤长、腰围、适穿尺码区间、熨烫温度）与洗涤条目，一律改写成 {callout_N}；面料成分含量、健康与透气类功效断言全部删除，不重新编造。品类以图为准：主体是男童圆领宽松短袖 T 恤加松紧腰多袋工装五分短裤的两件套，与任务提示中的工装长裤不符，故 leaf 与画面按短裤描述，文件名与 id 仍按要求保留 gongzhuangku 原slug。productFamily 按服饰取 fashion；L1/L2 取 taxonomy 精确串「母婴」/「童装」。
